versions.changelog:
GenerateBot all-in-one content generation and management skill released.

- Enables content searches, generation from URLs or topics, and script creation via GenerateBot API.
- Supports RSS feed sourcing, management, and parsing at no credit cost.
- Pipeline system for generating articles, social posts, scripts, carousels, and image suggestions.
- Includes endpoints for saving, listing, and managing generated content.
- Supports publishing to major CMS and social platforms with enrichment and rewriting features.
- Comprehensive OpenAPI documentation for all supported actions included.
